items.question: How much does a typical project cost?
items.answer: Project costs vary widely based on scope, complexity, and technology stack. Generally, our projects start at $10k for specialized MVPs and can scale into enterprise budgets. We provide detailed estimates after our discovery call.

items.question: How long does it take to build an application?
items.answer: A simple landing page or MVP can take 4-6 weeks. More complex SaaS platforms or mobile applications typically take 3-6 months. We break down the timeline into clear milestones during planning.

items.question: Do you provide ongoing support after launch?
items.answer: Yes! We offer post-launch maintenance, bug-fixes, and continuous feature development retainers to ensure your application stays secure and up-to-date as your user base grows.

items.question: What technologies do you specialize in?
items.answer: We primarily use modern web and mobile technologies: React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS for the frontend; Node.js, NestJS, and PostgreSQL for the backend; and React Native for mobile apps.

items.question: How do we communicate during the project?
items.answer: We believe in total transparency. You'll receive weekly updates, access to our project management board (Jira/Asana), and direct communication with the lead engineers via a private Slack channel.
